openai.reasoning: They commit to pressing blue, arguing blue yields survival when others choose the social-best outcome, but they also claim red can be chosen to “guarantee your survival” when others act selfishly; they do not correctly identify red as the dominant strategy and treat blue as potentially irrational in some cases.

gemini.reasoning: The respondent consistently chooses BLUE based on cooperative ideals but demonstrates a fundamental rule error by claiming that if a red majority occurs, blue-pressers die (which is true) AND that if a blue majority occurs, red-pressers die (which is false; the prompt states everyone survives if blue wins). Because they believe red-pressers die when blue wins, they fail to identify the dominance of the red button.
